_doc: Paid / rate-limited third-party endpoints, parked out of the default registry. They are NOT loaded unless $TABBENCH_LLM_EXTRA_MODELS names this file (os.pathsep-separated paths), e.g. TABBENCH_LLM_EXTRA_MODELS=src/tabbench_llm/llm/data/llm_models_external.json. Parked because the first full grid pass was rate-limited rather than compute-limited: the majority of their cells returned HTTP 429, which left each model scored on a different subset of datasets. Re-add them only with a quota that can cover the whole grid.
